entries.title: Sufix Castable Invisiline Fluorocarbon
entries.seoTitle: Sufix Invisiline Fluorocarbon Diameter & Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Compare verified Sufix Castable Invisiline diameters and exact 100-yard SKUs. Plan a working length over backing without confusing mainline with Invisiline Leader.
entries.excerpt: Castable Invisiline is Sufix's 100% fluorocarbon mainline for spinning and casting reels. This guide covers the Clear 100-yard 680-9xxC spools from 4 to 20 lb, with each package tied to its exact SKU. Invisiline Leader and Ice are separate products.

entries.title: Sufix Calibr8 15 lb
entries.seoTitle: Sufix Calibr8 15 lb Diameter & Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Plan a Sufix Calibr8 15 lb fill using verified SKU 694-015L, Neon Lime and its nominal 150-yard package. Other strengths and spool options remain outside this guide.
entries.excerpt: This Calibr8 guide covers one source-verified offering: 15 lb Neon Lime, SKU 694-015L, in a nominal 150-yard spool. Manufacturer-owned launch photos show the exact strength, diameter, package length and SKU. Other Calibr8 strengths, colors and lengths are not included.

entries.title: SpiderWire Stealth Braid
entries.seoTitle: Stealth Braid 2016 Japan Diameter Guide | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Plan from the 2016 Japan Stealth Braid listing: 50/65 lb Moss Green, published actual diameters and exact 125-yard SKUs. Not current US specifications.
entries.excerpt: This is a narrow reference to Pure Fishing Japan's 2016-launch Stealth Braid listing of US-labeled imports: 50 and 65 lb Moss Green in exact 125-yard SKUs. The manufacturer gives standard actual diameters of .419 and .447 mm. These regional historical values are not interchangeable with current US advertised diameters, newer Stealth packaging or a mono-equivalent pound-test label.

entries.title: Stren Super Knot
entries.seoTitle: Stren Super Knot Diameter & Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Compare Stren Super Knot's 2014 US Clear and Lo-Vis Green diameter chart and 220-yard fillers. Historical specifications, not current availability.
entries.excerpt: This guide covers Stren Super Knot as documented in the 2014 US manufacturer catalog: eight 4-20 lb test steps, Clear and Lo-Vis Green, on 220-yard fillers. Super Knot is the named monofilament product, not later Power Knot or adjacent MagnaThin. These are historical specifications, not evidence of current stock or unchanged formulation.

entries.title: Stren Fluorocast
entries.seoTitle: Stren Fluorocast Diameter & Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Plan reel fills from Stren FluoroCast's 2014 US Clear chart: seven verified diameters, 100-yard pony and 200-yard filler packages. Historical reference only.
entries.excerpt: This guide is limited to Stren FluoroCast's 2014 US Clear specifications. The manufacturer documented seven 4-17 lb test steps with 100-yard pony and 200-yard filler packages. FluoroCast appears separately from Stren 100% Fluoro on that same catalog page; their diameters and color scopes are not interchangeable. Historical listings do not establish current stock or unchanged formulation.

entries.title: Stren Sonic Braid
entries.seoTitle: Sonic Braid 40 lb Legacy Label Guide | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Plan from the original SCB30040-22 Sonic Braid label: 40 lb, .25 mm, Lo-Vis Green and 300 yards. A narrow legacy reference, not current availability.
entries.excerpt: This guide covers one readable legacy Sonic Braid label, SCB30040-22: 40 lb Lo-Vis Green, .25 mm and 300 yards. The label also says 10 lb test diameter, but that is a mono-equivalent comparison, not the physical diameter used here. Stren's 2014 US catalog confirms the Sonic Braid and GlideCoat family; the photographed label itself is undated.

entries.title: P-Line CXX X-Tra Strong
entries.seoTitle: P-Line CXX US Package Diameters & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Verified US Moss Green CXX 10 and 12 lb package-label diameters and 300-yard lengths, with reel-capacity estimates and backing guidance.
entries.excerpt: CXX X-Tra Strong is P-Line's copolymer main line. This US package-label reference covers Moss Green CXXFG 10 and 12 lb in 300-yard cartons. The photos do not establish a production year or the newest edition; other CXX colors and packages are not covered.

entries.title: P-Line FloroClear
entries.seoTitle: P-Line FloroClear US Label Diameters & Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: P-Line FloroClear US label reference: historical 2021 10 lb/600 yd and pictured 12 lb/300 yd specifications, reel capacity, and package differences.
entries.excerpt: FloroClear is a fluorocarbon-coated copolymer, not 100% fluorocarbon. This US reference combines a historical 2021 catalog label for Clear 10 lb/600 yd with a photographed Clear 12 lb/300 yd filler package of unestablished production year. It is not a current-edition or stock claim.

entries.title: P-Line CX Premium
entries.seoTitle: P-Line CX Premium US Diameters & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Verified US Moss Green CX Premium 6 and 8 lb carton diameters and 300-yard packages, with capacity estimates and coated-copolymer spooling guidance.
entries.excerpt: CX Premium combines copolymer with a fluorocarbon-silicone coating. This US reference covers the photographed Moss Green CXFMG 6 and 8 lb, 300-yard cartons. Their production years are unestablished; the labels do not establish a current edition or stock position. CX Premium is not CXX X-Tra Strong.

entries.title: P-Line Tactical Fluorocarbon: 2021 US Reference
entries.seoTitle: P-Line Tactical 2021 US Diameter & Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Historical 2021 US Tactical 15 lb/1000 yd manufacturer-label reference, with diameter-based reel capacity and explicit limits on other strengths.
entries.excerpt: Historical 2021 US reference only: the official catalog depicts Clear Tactical PTB1000-15, 15 lb, .0138 in/.352 mm, on a 1,000-yard bulk spool. Tactical is a fluorocarbon main line. This page does not assert current edition, current availability, or specifications for the rest of the range.

entries.title: P-Line HALO Fluorocarbon
entries.seoTitle: P-Line HALO US Label Diameters & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Verified US Mist Green HALO 6, 8 and 10 lb manufacturer-label diameters and 200-yard packages, with fluorocarbon mainline capacity guidance.
entries.excerpt: HALO is P-Line's 100% fluorocarbon Co-Fluoride main line. This US reference covers three photographed Mist Green HF 200-yard cartons: 6, 8, and 10 lb. The photos have no established production year, so this is a package-label reference, not a current-edition or availability claim.

entries.title: P-Line EndurX Braid
entries.seoTitle: P-Line EndurX 8X US Diameters & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: EndurX 8X US label reference: 20 lb Electric Green and 30 lb Midnight Black, each 300 yards, with verified diameters and braid-capacity guidance.
entries.excerpt: This is the eight-carrier EndurX 8X mainline reference, not an EndurX four-carrier product. The exact US labels are Electric Green 20 lb/300 yd and Midnight Black 30 lb/300 yd. Production years are unestablished; the photographed Zero Fade packaging does not establish the latest edition or current availability.

entries.title: P-Line TCB 8 Braid: US Teflon-Label Reference
entries.seoTitle: P-Line TCB 8 Teflon-Label Diameters & Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: US Teflon-labeled TCB 8 package reference: Green 20 lb/150 yd and Yellow 50 lb/300 yd, with 2021 catalog identity and diameter-based capacity.
entries.excerpt: US Teflon-label reference: Green TCB 8 20 lb/150 yd and Hi Vis Yellow 50 lb/300 yd. The official 2021 US catalog connects X-Braid, XTCB-8, and this Teflon-labeled family. The photos have no established production year; this page does not assert the current Slick Coat formulation is identical or that these packages are available now.

entries.title: Hi-Seas 100% Fluorocarbon Line
entries.seoTitle: Hi-Seas Fluorocarbon 25 lb Diameter & Capacity | ReelCalc
entries.seoDescription: Check the catalog-listed Hi-Seas CFC-F200-25 mainline: 25 lb, .018 inch / .45 mm and 200 yards. Compare reel capacity with explicit source and availability limits.
entries.excerpt: Hi-Seas 100% Fluorocarbon Line is the CFC-F200 mainline family, distinct from the brand's leader-only and coated lines. This limited chart covers the catalog-listed 25 lb Clear filler spool: .018 inch / .45 mm and 200 yards, confirmed by its exact package photo. Retail availability is not verified.
